---
name: UI polish
about: Report layout, formatting, readability, or visual hierarchy improvements
labels: ui
---

## Affected view & state
Which tab, section, and state (e.g., collapsed vs. expanded, dark vs. light, empty vs. populated)?

## What feels off
Describe the layout, copy, formatting, or readability issue (attach a screenshot if helpful).

## Expected outcome
What should the user immediately see and understand?

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clean alignment, tabular figures, and dark/light parity
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility preserved
- [ ] Unit/panel tests updated, version bumped per `AGENTS.md`, and `panel/index.html` rebuilt
